clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands' far west, Sundown Marsh holds deep water, stagnant pools, and dangerous wildlife. An eccentric pair keeps a solitary home along its muddy borders.

Sundown Marsh fills the Wetlands' deepest, westernmost reaches, where deep water and thick mud hide a dense population of predators. Giant crocolisks, shifting oozes, roaming raptors, and territorial Mosshide gnolls move through the mist. Most travelers keep to the main cobblestone road between Menethil Harbor and Ironforge, leaving this corner largely untamed.

A lonely stone cottage with a churning windmill stands amid the marsh's hazards. The gnome Fradd Swiftgear and the dwarf Wenna Silkbeard make their living scavenging the bog. They sell curiosities and rare trade recipes recovered from the mire to travelers who brave its aggressive denizens.
